brief:
Likud party has outlined preconditions for forming a "national unity government" that include halting boycotts of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and ultra-Orthodox parties, the Ma'an news agency reported. The party demands public renunciation of any partnership with Arab parties and absolute rejection of establishing a Palestinian state.

The statement also calls for maintaining current security arrangements in Gaza. These conditions represent core positions that have defined Netanyahu's coalition negotiations and reflect ideological red lines the party considers non-negotiable for broader government formation.

title: Likud sets conditions for Palestinian state rejection in unity government
